metricSemantics.clicks: Completed pointer activations; selections/file choices are separate semantic operations. A click that also navigates appears in both dimensions, not summed as two distinct physical inputs.
metricSemantics.keyboardActions: Explicit standalone key presses only. Playwright fill is a semantic field entry and does not claim a count of physical typing keys.
metricSemantics.filledFields: New literal entries; keep selections and fileSelections visible. First-flow counts file as a filled field, shared helper records it separately; do not compare totals without noting the convention.
metricSemantics.repeatedFields: Existing application facts entered again; new exception/date/review reason is not repeated. Authentication re-entry is separate and now explicitly counted in operator recovery.
metricSemantics.decisions: Sources use different explicit conventions: first-flow counts each activated control/selection; standalone course entry excludes disclosure from business decisions; shared recorder flags specified business choices. Preserve definitions; do not equate totals blindly.
metricSemantics.navigation: Page transitions are distinct from clicks and not silently excluded when crossing roles/tasks. Some existing cases start at a prepared URL; that boundary must remain visible.
metricSemantics.dialogs: Preserve observer scope: JS page dialogs, DOM application modals and native OS picker/print UI are different. Shared helper observes JS and visible DOM dialogs; native picker and printer UI are not inspected.
metricSemantics.confirmations: Separate explicit consent/approval/publication/business commitment from reversible viewing/navigation/download. Missing old values are unknown, not zero.
metricSemantics.manualRefresh: Explicit operator reload/update actions; automatic background polling is not a manual refresh.
metricSemantics.elapsedTime: Measured automated wall time, not human effort or typing speed. Assertions/API readback/render waits and some screenshots are included. Excluded geometry time is recorded separately. First-flow action timestamps are cumulative; shared helper per-step timestamps are durations and must not be aggregated the same way.
